profile.name: Te Xiao
profile.headline: From Flexible Sensors to Wireless Biomedical Systems.
intro: I’m Te Xiao (肖特), a researcher at Waseda University working on flexible biosensors and wireless sensing systems, with a particular focus on smart contact lenses for biomedical applications.

paragraphs: My research at Waseda began with wireless power transfer to soft contact lenses during my master’s studies. In my doctoral research, I turned to flexible biosensors and wireless readout for measuring signals from the eye.
My research interests include flexible sensor fabrication, wireless sensing, and the integration of electronic devices into soft biomedical systems.

skills.label: Flexible Sensors & Materials
skills.detail: Resistive and capacitive sensors, PEDOT and PEDOT:PSS, wrinkled gold, hydrogels, PVA, PDMS, and Ecoflex.

skills.label: Microfabrication
skills.detail: Photolithography, gold evaporation, electroplating, lift-off, EDOT polymerization, and ultrathin antenna fabrication.

skills.label: RF & Wireless Sensing
skills.detail: PT-symmetric wireless sensing, RF resonators, antenna design, impedance matching, and S-parameter analysis.

skills.label: Measurement & Validation
skills.detail: VNA and LCR measurements, circuit assembly, RF troubleshooting, device characterization, and animal-model validation.

skills.label: Engineering Software
skills.detail: HFSS for electromagnetic simulation, Shapr3D for 3D modeling, MATLAB and DataGraph for analysis and visualization, and familiarity with Blender.
